events.factual_description: Blues Alley's authorized InstantSeats pages present Mario Wellmann Trio on Tuesday, September 15, 2026 for 7:00 PM and 9:30 PM sets, each at a $30 face-value general-admission price plus a $7 fee. The event is part of the Chilean Jazz Series / Chilean Jazz Week and is co-presented with the Embassy of Chile. The program centers Ecos del Sur, Wellmann's debut album as a leader, freshly recorded in New York with engineer Joseph Branciforte and funded by Chile's Fondo de la Música. Blues Alley describes the project as synthesizing contemporary jazz language with rhythmic and melodic traditions from Chile and Latin America and frames the Washington date as an early hearing only weeks after the recording sessions, ahead of a late-2026 release. The current primary event page identifies Wellmann and the trio billing but does not name the other two performers, so their identities are left unresolved rather than inferred from other tour dates.

en.why_it_matters: Ecos del Sur gives this club date a real center: Wellmann is bringing newly recorded music shaped by the landscapes and musical memory of Chile into a small Washington room only weeks after the sessions, with Chilean Jazz Week and the Embassy of Chile making the cultural exchange part of the performance rather than background branding. The attraction is the guitar-led meeting of contemporary jazz language with Chilean and broader Latin American rhythmic and melodic ideas at the moment the project is becoming a record.
en.trip_verdict: For the DMV, this is exactly the kind of local discovery worth using an open Tuesday for. Pick whichever Blues Alley set fits; I would not displace a harder-to-replace night or build regional travel around it.

es.why_it_matters: Ecos del Sur le da un centro claro a esta fecha: Wellmann trae a una sala pequeña de Washington música recién grabada, nacida de los paisajes y la memoria musical del sur de Chile, apenas unas semanas después de las sesiones. Chilean Jazz Week y la copresentación de la Embajada de Chile vuelven el intercambio cultural parte del concierto y no simple contexto. Lo interesante es escuchar, todavía en etapa de estreno público, cómo la guitarra y el lenguaje del jazz contemporáneo se cruzan con ideas rítmicas y melódicas chilenas y latinoamericanas mientras el proyecto se convierte en disco.
es.trip_verdict: Desde el DMV, es una buena fecha para aprovechar un martes libre y escoger el set de Blues Alley que mejor embone. No movería una noche más difícil de reemplazar ni armaría un viaje regional alrededor de ella.
